scope: Automatic weapon acquisition, aim and fire; console modes Automatic/Hold fire; no manual lock or trigger controls.
owner_direction: All weapons are automated; player does not aim or lock manually.
Console actions may change operating modes; weapons acquire and fire themselves.
implementation: One target is acquired automatically within 60 km and clear planetary line of sight. Tracking is lost and reacquired without user input.
Start/reset defaults to Automatic, with a 0.85-second first-shot delay and ongoing cooldown. First outgoing shot engages the drone.
Hold fire retains sensors and blocks outgoing fire; incoming damage continues after engagement.
Mode survives view/station changes; automatic weapons continue while walking. Mode changes require a station or exterior control.
Removed T/X actions and manual lock/fire buttons. Unrestricted prototype turret aiming replaces manual bow alignment.
Pause, route and graphics recovery behavior remains; temporary training state ends on reload, travel or craft change.

checks.name: Start practice automatically acquires and fires at Sentinel without aiming, locking or trigger input
Hold fire keeps automatic tracking, stops outgoing shots and allows incoming damage; old shortcuts do nothing
Pause and settings freeze combat; modes persist across views; automatic weapons continue while walking away from the console
Automatic fire wins the encounter without trigger input and terminal state stops both weapons
Hold fire does not protect from defeat; shield overflow, disabled flight and automatic-mode reset remain correct
Repeated encounters reuse resources; narrow native controls switch automatic and hold modes
Leaving range stops both guns; returning automatically reacquires and resumes fire
Context restoration stays paused; reload and travel clear practice without changing the saved craft

rendered_review.findings: Automatic/Hold fire states and accessible controls fit desktop and narrow layouts. Instrument updates remain throttled; captures can precede the next instrument refresh.

knowledge_lookup.limit: Selected catalog only. No external implementation reused or research submitted.

limits: One stationary training target, instant pulse hits and temporary damage. General enemy tactics and physical destruction remain unbuilt.
Prototype turret can aim in any direction. Mount-specific arcs and own-hull occlusion are not modeled.
Eight focused combat groups rerun; previous broad gameplay and safety checks remain historical in combat-verification.json.
Installed isolated Chrome 157.0.8103.78 on RTX 5090. Physical phones/laptops, other engines, Electron runtime, long play and fresh agent sessions remain untested.
No commit, push, deployment, transfer, paid generation or research submission.
